data.title: Park Heights
data.about:
Welcome to Park Heights in Dubai Hills Estate. Surrounded by lush greenery with 1, 2, 3 bedroom apartments, Park Heights is your ideal pick if you love a tranquil environment to live in. As a resident, you can take a nice leisurely walk at the community park, or enjoy the uninterrupted views of the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai from your large windows.

You will have access to the best of the amenities, including a golf course, retail outlets, dining options, infinity-edge pools and kids’ play areas. Located just steps away from the Dubai Hills Estate Mall, these homes are the perfect haven you are looking for.
